name: slide-handouts
description: Turn slide handouts into bigger, easier-to-read printable pages with room for notes. Activates for: (1) slide handouts and printable slides with notes, from a PowerPoint handout PDF, a slide deck PDF, or a PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides file, (2) bigger slides or a different number of slides per page, (3) note-taking lines, a dot grid, blank space or fillable notes boxes beside or under each slide, (4) saving and reusing a usual handout layout.
